description: Land Title Settlement Department - Nivithigala, Nivithigala D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620400 (22/758)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including details of land parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and title classifications. The content falls squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements.
